description: This file contains FastAPI route handlers for compatibility endpoints related to submissions, including creating, running quality gates, approving, and publishing submissions. It provides test support functionalities such as auto-creating minimal submissions and handling simplified payloads for testing purposes.

classes.name: SimplifiedSubmissionPayload
classes.description: Pydantic model for simplified submission payload used in test compatibility endpoints.

methods.name: _validate_payload
methods.description: Validator method for SimplifiedSubmissionPayload to ensure required fields are present based on payload type.

methods.name: get_or_create_test_user
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test user for anonymous requests during tests.

methods.name: ensure_submission_exists_for_tests
methods.description: Ensures a minimal draft and submission exist for testing purposes, creating them if necessary.

methods.name: create_submission_compat
methods.description: API endpoint to create a submission using simplified payloads for testing.

methods.name: run_quality_gates_compat
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger validation/quality gates for a submission, auto-creating minimal data if missing.

methods.name: approve_submission_compat
methods.description: API endpoint to approve a submission, with security checks for authorization.

methods.name: publish_submission_compat
methods.description: API endpoint to publish a submission, auto-provisioning if the submission does not exist.
